prompt:
Generate a transparent game SPRITE SHEET of nine dry-climate trees. Use the attached geometry as the elevated isometric CAMERA guide: top faces are very visible, trunks short below the canopy, radial branch spread in the horizontal2:1 plane. Replace the simple geometry with restrained painted organic trees. IMPORTANT remove every green ground diamond completely to alpha0. Do NOT return frontal tree illustrations. Camera looks down onto the TOP of crowns from35 degrees elevation, fixed orthographic three-quarter view. Crown tops and layered radial foliage dominate, crowns conceal inner trunk forks. Northwest light, muted sage and deep olive greens, warm brown wood. Full plants with clear empty gutters in exactly3x3 equal square cells. No tiny leaves or needles, lettering or UI. Root foot near85% cell height; canopy and branches wholly contained in its own cell. 
Subjects from this list only, canopy view overrides frontal-trunk descriptions. Dry climate dusty olive and sage crowns, warm gray/brown bark. Palm FROND ROSETTES seen from above; we see radial star shape of fronds instead of a sideways arch.
Slot 1: desert-willow, 6m tall, 118.3px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Slender warm grey forked trunk, loose pale green crown with a few broad muted mauve patches.
Slot 2: olive-tree, 6.67m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Gnarled thick grey trunk with separated rounded silvery green crown masses.
Slot 3: carob, 7.33m tall, 144.6px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Dense broad dark olive dome above a short stout branching brown trunk.
Slot 4: argan, 6.67m tall, 131.5px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Low wide irregular muted green crown and sculptural split dark trunk.
Slot 5: mopane, 8m tall, 157.8px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Upright dense warm olive crown on a clear reddish grey forked trunk.
Slot 6: marula, 8.67m tall, 170.9px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Broad rounded soft sage canopy on a smooth pale grey stout trunk.
Slot 7: bottle-tree, 8m tall, 157.8px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Distinctively swollen pale green-grey trunk with a small rounded olive canopy.
Slot 8: euphorbia-tree, 6m tall, 118.3px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Sculptural succulent candelabra of thick muted green upright branched stems.
Slot 9: desert-cypress, 9.33m tall, 184.1px vertical tree height in the normalized256px cell. Tall slender blue-green pointed column on a short exposed warm grey trunk.
Relative size from metre heights; preserve smaller plants. Complete crowns and root feet with 12% empty gutter. Genuine alpha; no ground discs.
